name: zcode-plugin-langfuse
description: Fail-open Langfuse tracing for ZCode sessions, prompts, tool calls, and assistant responses.

description_i18n.en: Fail-open Langfuse tracing for ZCode sessions, prompts, tool calls, and assistant responses.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 为 ZCode 会话、提示词、工具调用和助手回复提供 fail-open 的 Langfuse 追踪。

langfuse_public_key.title: Langfuse public key
langfuse_public_key.description: Langfuse project public key. You can also provide LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY in the ZCode process environment.

langfuse_secret_key.title: Langfuse secret key
langfuse_secret_key.description: Langfuse project secret key. It is used only by the local hook process and is never written to hook output.

langfuse_base_url.title: Langfuse base URL
langfuse_base_url.description: HTTPS Langfuse host, for example https://cloud.langfuse.com or a self-hosted HTTPS URL. Plain HTTP is rejected.

langfuse_user_id.title: Langfuse user ID
langfuse_user_id.description: Optional stable user identifier attached to traces. Leave empty to omit it.

capture_prompts.title: Capture prompts
capture_prompts.description: Include user prompts and assistant responses in Langfuse. Disable for metadata-only tracing.

capture_tool_inputs.title: Capture tool inputs
capture_tool_inputs.description: Include tool names and inputs in Langfuse spans.

capture_tool_outputs.title: Capture tool outputs
capture_tool_outputs.description: Include tool results and errors in Langfuse spans.

max_capture_chars.title: Maximum captured characters
max_capture_chars.description: Maximum characters per captured prompt, tool payload, or response. Larger values are truncated.

debug.title: Debug diagnostics
debug.description: Write non-sensitive lifecycle diagnostics to stderr. Disabled by default.
